methodBoundary: Five anti-cases were frozen before theory coding; this audit occurs only after Pass A and primary Pass B were frozen.

cases.finding: Useful X-ray observation/action preceded mature mechanism and safety. Useful local intervention need not wait for global causal closure, but first use is not general/net validation.
A high-quality null outlived its producers' interpretation. Evidence quality and evaluator semantics are separable.

Independent coding legitimately makes S1 NOT_APPLICABLE, breaking the prior ceiling and exposing primary overcoding. Raw S4 CONTRADICTS is a quantifier error: a fixed specialized method can be optimal inside one stable world; S4 concerns changing regimes. Ford is nevertheless a real anti-case against default generality/flexibility preference.
Koch's true bacteriological authority did not transfer automatically to tuberculin therapy; expertise/authority is consequence-domain scoped.
Present non-tractability/missing mechanism does not imply zero future option value; later vindication cannot be back-projected into present proof or present tractability.

rawIndependentContradictions.reason: A fixed specialized method can be conditionally optimal inside one stable world. S4 requires condition dependence across relevant regimes, not perpetual switching inside a regime.

worldModelUpdate: Anti-cases most usefully narrow quantifiers, applicability and value dimensions. Three epochs still yield no adjudicated direct contradiction, so falsifiability pressure remains active.
